 Eala holds firm against Jones to reach Hong Kong second round
 Match Reaction 
 2m read
 03 Nov 2026
 1d ago
 Second seed Alexandra Eala held off Australian lucky loser Emerson Jones in straight sets to advance to the second round of the Prudential Hong Kong Open on Tuesday evening.
 Eala made a fast start, racing to a 4-0 lead in the opening set. Jones, who entered the main draw following the withdrawal of American Alycia Parks, fought back to close the gap to 4-3 before Eala held on to take the set 6-4.
 The Filipino, ranked a career-high No. 17 in the WTA PIF Rankings this week, made another strong start in the second set, building a 5-1 lead. Jones recovered one of the breaks, but Eala held firm to complete a 6-4, 6-3 victory in one hour, 23 minutes.
 🎾 Crowd favourite and No. 2 seed Alexandra Eala delights the fans with a 6-4, 6-3 victory over Emerson Jones, securing her place in the next round! 🔥💜 #PHKTO #PrudentialHongKong #DiscoverHongKong #WTA250 #HKCTA #HKTS #NextGenAces #GameOn #MajorSportsEventsCommittee #MSEC https://t.co/gHuiMATob7
— HongKong Tennis Open (@HKTennisOpen) November 3, 2026 
 Eala will next face Czech teenager Tereza Valentova, who defeated qualifier Himeno Sakatsume 6-3, 7-5 in another first-round match Tuesday.
 Top seed Cirstea and No. 5 Gisbon also reach second round
 Earlier in the day, top seed Sorana Cirstea rallied from an early break down in the final set to defeat Maria Timofeeva 7-6, 1-6, 7-5 and advance to the second round. Cirstea will next face American Mary Stoiana, who defeated seven-time Grand Slam champion Venus Williams in straight sets on Monday.
 Terrific hitting 👏 Sorana Cirstea fully entertained in her match against Timofeeva. The No.1 seed advanced to the Round of 16 in Hong Kong, winning 7-6(6), 1-6, 7-5! #PHKTO2026 https://t.co/uMZ6XmLIa7
— wta (@WTA) November 3, 2026 
 Fifth seed Talia Gibson, who reached a career-high ranking of No. 36 this week, overcame a 5-3 deficit in the opening set to defeat Oleksandra Oliynykova 7-6, 6-1. 
 However, No. 7 seed Liudmila Samsonova suffered a first-round upset at the hands of Alexandra Shubladze. Making her WTA Tour main-draw debut, Shubladze rallied for a 5-7, 6-1, 6-2 victory to advance to the second round.

 Also advancing were Maya Joint, who won an all-Australian clash against Maddison Inglis 7-5, 6-2, and Zeynep Sonmez, who defeated Dayana Yastremska 6-4, 6-2.
